originalTitle: 5 Oil and Gas Stocks That Crushed Third-Quarter Earnings Estimates
summary: Energy earnings jumped 151% in Q3 as ONEOK, Occidental, APA, Phillips 66 and Valero beat Wall Street estimates, with refiners posting the biggest gains.
content:
We are currently at the tail-end of the third quarter earnings season, with more than 90% of S&P 500 companies having reported, and it's proven to be yet another bumper season. According to FactSet data , the index has reported 31.9% Y/Y average earnings growth, marking the third consecutive quarter that earnings growth has exceeded 25%. All 11 sectors of the U.S. market have posted positive earnings and revenue growth, with seven reporting double-digit earnings growth led by the energy, IT and materials sectors.

The energy sector has posted the highest earnings growth amongst the 11 sectors at 151.2% Y/Y as well as the second-highest revenue growth at 35.7% Y/Y, thanks to higher energy prices.

Oil prices averaged $85.68/bbl in the third quarter, ~32% higher compared to the corresponding quarter a year ago. At the sub-industry level, 4 of the 5 sub-industries in the energy sector have reported positive earnings growth led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (542%), Integrated Oil & Gas (141%), Oil & Gas Exploration & Production (83%), and Oil & Gas Storage & Transportation (30%). Only the Oil & Gas Equipment & Services (-3%) sub-industry has reported a decline in earnings.

Here are 5 Oil & Gas Companies that have easily exceeded Wall Street expectations:

       Market Cap: $55.5B

       52-Week Returns: 28.8%

Record Permian Basin volumes lifted ONEOK's (NYSE:OKE) third-quarter earnings, and the Tulsa-based pipeline operator is raising its spending to add processing, pipeline and export capacity in the Permian and on the Gulf Coast. ONEOK gathers, processes, transports and stores natural gas, natural gas liquids (NGLs), refined products and crude oil across a 60,000-mile network linking producers to domestic and international markets. NGL raw feed throughput rose 6% to nearly 1.7 million barrels per day, with the Gulf Coast/Permian region up 16%. Refined products shipments climbed 6% and Permian gas processing volumes rose 4%. Those gains raised adjusted EBITDA 6% year-over-year to $2.24 billion.

ONEOK's headline earnings of $2.13 per diluted share beat the consensus by 63 cents, though 53 cents of that came from a one-time, non-cash tax benefit tied to a corporate reorganization. Stripped of the benefit, the company still beat consensus by a dime.

Management raised full-year guidance for the third time this year, citing record Permian volumes and the Permian Midland assets ONEOK bought from Brazos Midstream. The adjusted EBITDA midpoint rose by 200 million dollars to $8.55 billion, and the company now expects earnings of 6.30 dollars per diluted share at the midpoint.

ONEOK raised its 2026 capital budget to about $3.5 billion from 3.2 billion to speed up construction of the Cutter II processing plant and a Delaware Basin NGL expansion. That expansion will add 245,000 barrels per day of takeaway capacity in the third quarter of 2027. ONEOK is also expanding its export capacity. Volumes at its Galena Park export terminal rose about 15% in the quarter, and a 400,000-barrel-per-day LPG export terminal at Texas City is due in early 2028.

       Market Cap: $57.4B

       52-Week Returns: 36.8%

Occidental Petroleum (NYSE:OXY) cut its principal debt to $10 billion in the third quarter, reaching that target ahead of schedule . The Houston-based oil and gas producer repaid 1.8 billion dollars of principal in the quarter and 10.4 billion so far this year, after closing the sale of OxyChem , its chemicals business, to Berkshire Hathaway in January. Production averaged 1.43 million barrels of oil equivalent per day, 7,000 above the midpoint of guidance.

Adjusted earnings of $1.91 per share beat Wall Street's consensus of 1.34 by 57 cents, and free cash flow reached about 2.8 billion dollars, the highest since 2022. Net sales of 6.57 billion rose 19% from a year earlier, excluding the divested chemicals business, but fell just short of the 6.61 billion consensus.

Occidental's next target is to cut principal debt to 6 billion dollars. At that level, management expects debt to run at about one times EBITDA with WTI at $50 a barrel. The company already counts about 740 million dollars a year in interest savings from the debt it has repaid.

Lower debt is the largest single piece of Occidental's plan to raise annual sustainable cash flow by more than $4 billion by 2030, about 95% above 2025 levels. Corporate savings, mostly lower interest costs, account for 1.7 billion dollars of that increase. Occidental expects sustaining capital to fall from 5.4 billion in 2025 to 4.5 billion by the end of 2029 as its base decline rate eases from about 25% to 20%. The company also plans to cut U.S. onshore new-well costs by 12% and domestic operating and transportation costs by 10%, and to spend less on its Low Carbon Ventures unit. Management expects about 85% of the gain to hold even at lower oil prices.

       Market Cap: $15.9B

       52-Week Returns: 93.3%

APA Corporation (NASDAQ:APA) beat its Permian production targets in the third quarter and is using the extra cash to buy back shares and cut debt ahead of first oil from its GranMorgu project offshore Suriname in mid-2028. The Houston-based parent of Apache Corporation explores for and produces oil and gas in the U.S., Egypt and the UK North Sea, and became a pure upstream company after exiting its midstream pipeline business. U.S. oil output averaged 128,000 barrels per day in the quarter, 4,000 above guidance, on high uptime, earlier well turn-ins and strong new-well results in the Permian. APA raised its full-year U.S. oil forecast to 124,000 barrels per day from an initial 120,000 to 122,000.

chineseTitle: 5只超出第三季度盈利预期的石油和天然气股票
chineseSummary: ONEOK、Occidental、APA、Phillips 66 和 Valero 超出华尔街预期，第三季度能源盈利跃升 151%，其中炼油商涨幅最大。
chineseContent:
目前，我们正处于第三季度财报季的尾声，超过 90% 的标准普尔 500 指数公司已公布财报，事实证明，这又是一个丰收季。 FactSet数据显示，该指数平均盈利同比增长31.9%，连续第三个季度盈利增长超过25%。美国市场的所有 11 个行业均实现了正盈利和收入增长，其中 7 个行业实现了两位数的盈利增长，其中能源、IT 和材料行业领先。

由于能源价格上涨，能源行业的盈利增长率在 11 个行业中最高，同比增长 151.2%，收入增长率排名第二，同比增长 35.7%。

第三季度平均油价为 85.68 美元/桶，比去年同期高出约 32%。从子行业来看，能源行业5个子行业中，有4个子行业盈利正增长，其中油气炼制与销售（542%）、综合油气（141%）、油气勘探与生产（83%）和油气储运（30%）为主导。只有石油和天然气设备及服务（-3%）子行业的收益出现下降。

以下是 5 家轻松超出华尔街预期的石油和天然气公司：

       市值：$55.5B

       52 周回报率：28.8%

二叠纪盆地创纪录的产量提升了 ONEOK (NYSE:OKE) 第三季度的收益，这家总部位于塔尔萨的管道运营商正在增加支出，以增加二叠纪和墨西哥湾沿岸的加工、管道和出口能力。 ONEOK 通过将生产商与国内和国际市场连接起来的 60,000 英里网络收集、加工、运输和储存天然气、液化天然气 (NGL)、精炼产品和原油。 NGL 原料吞吐量增长 6%，达到每天近 170 万桶，其中墨西哥湾沿岸/二叠纪地区增长 16%。炼油产品出货量增长 6%，二叠纪天然气加工量增长 4%。这些收益使调整后 EBITDA 同比增长 6%，达到 22.4 亿美元。

ONEOK 的稀释后每股收益为 2.13 美元，比市场预期高出 63 美分，尽管其中 53 美分来自与公司重组相关的一次性非现金税收优惠。剔除收益后，该公司仍以微弱优势超出市场预期。

管理层今年第三次上调全年指引，理由是二叠纪产量创纪录，以及 ONEOK 从 Brazos Midstream 购买的二叠纪 Midland 资产。调整后的 EBITDA 中点增加了 2 亿美元，达到 85.5 亿美元，公司目前预计稀释后每股收益中点为 6.30 美元。

ONEOK 将 2026 年资本预算从 32 亿美元提高到约 35 亿美元，以加快 Cutter II 加工厂的建设和特拉华盆地 NGL 扩建。此次扩建将在 2027 年第三季度增加每天 245,000 桶的外卖能力。ONEOK 也在扩大其出口能力。本季度，其 Galena Park 出口码头的产量增长了约 15%，德克萨斯城的日产量 40 万桶的液化石油气出口码头将于 2028 年初竣工。

       市值：$57.4B

       52 周回报率：36.8%

西方石油公司 (NYSE:OXY) 第三季度将其本金债务削减至 100 亿美元，提前实现了这一目标。这家总部位于休斯敦的石油和天然气生产商在 1 月份将其化学品业务 OxyChem 出售给伯克希尔哈撒韦公司后，本季度偿还了 18 亿美元的本金，今年迄今偿还了 104 亿美元的本金。日均产量为 143 万桶油当量，比指导值中点高出 7,000 桶油当量。

调整后每股收益为1.91美元，比华尔街预期的1.34高57美分，自由现金流达到约28亿美元，为2022年以来最高。净销售额65.7亿美元，较上年同期增长19%（不包括剥离的化学品业务），但略低于预期的66.1亿美元。

西方石油公司的下一个目标是将本金债务削减至60亿美元。在此水平上，管理层预计债务将约为 EBITDA 的一倍，而 WTI 价格为每桶 50 美元。该公司预计每年可从其偿还的债务中节省约 7.4 亿美元的利息。

西方石油公司计划到 2030 年将年度可持续现金流增加超过 40 亿美元，比 2025 年的水平高出约 95%，而降低债务是该计划中最大的一项。企业储蓄（主要是较低的利息成本）占增量的 17 亿美元。西方石油公司预计，随着其基本下降率从约 25% 降至 20%，维持资本将从 2025 年的 54 亿美元下降至 2029 年底的 45 亿美元。该公司还计划将美国陆上新井成本削减 12%，将国内运营和运输成本削减 10%，并减少其低碳风险投资部门的支出。管理层预计，即使油价下跌，也能保持约 85% 的收益。

       市值：$15.9B

       52 周回报率：93.3%

APA Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：APA）第三季度超额完成了二叠纪盆地产量目标，并在 2028 年中期苏里南海上 GranMorgu 项目首次产油之前，利用额外现金回购股票并削减债务。阿帕奇公司的母公司总部位于休斯敦，在美国、埃及和英国北海勘探和生产石油和天然气，并在退出中游管道业务后成为一家纯粹的上游公司。由于正常运行时间较长、油井转产较早以及二叠纪新油井业绩强劲，本季度美国石油日均产量为 128,000 桶，比指导值高出 4,000 桶。 APA将美国全年石油产量预测从最初的12万桶/日上调至12.2万桶/日。

调整后每股收益 1.94 美元，比市场预期 1.60 多出 34 美分，总营收 27.7 亿美元，同比增长 30.9%，超出预期
